questions.a: Dashboard fatigue is what happens when you have plenty of charts and KPIs but little sense of what to do next. Operators of multi-location brands juggle reviews, NPS scores, surveys, social comments and store reports across many tabs. Digging for root causes takes time that frontline teams rarely have.

GenCI uses AI to analyze customer feedback for you and surface the patterns that matter. Instead of waiting for you to filter a chart, it tells you what's happening, why it matters and what to do about it. Momos uses a GenCI engine across reputation, experience, service and marketing signals as a thinking layer for every location.

questions.q: Are dashboards still useful for restaurant brands?
questions.a: Yes, dashboards still help you visualize data, but they leave the interpretation to you. That becomes hard when you manage many locations and need to act quickly. AI-generated insights work alongside them by flagging what's urgent and recommending next steps.

questions.q: What kind of insights can AI surface for multi-location operators?
questions.a: AI can point out which stores need coaching this week, the most common root cause behind low Google ratings, or a location at risk of slipping in its rating. These come as plain-language findings tied to specific locations. Your team can act on them without needing a data analyst.
